name: Quiet Hours
description: Switches your status to Do Not Disturb (or Idle, or Invisible) on a schedule you set, such as weeknights from 11 PM to 7 AM, and puts your old status back afterwards. One tap skips tonight. Works whenever Discord is open.
author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
contributors: Found with the decompiled Discord app by Wumpus-Central (discord-mobile-datamining)
